message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) based on Chinese criminal law.

Facts: Defendant operated forklift without certification, transporting wood veneer. Wood veneer slipped, hitting a worker (符某) on side, causing fatal injuries. He called police, attempted rescue, compensated, got victim's family forgiveness.

Potential charges: "过失致人死亡" (negligent homicide) or "过失致人死亡罪". Also possibly "危险作业致人死亡"? Under Chinese law, article 133 (dangerous behavior causing death) includes "在危险作业中未取得相应资格证书" leading to death, could be "过失致人死亡罪". Also "未取得特种作业操作证驾驶叉车" is violation of safety regulations, but criminal charge is "过失致人死亡". Could also be "交通肇事致人死亡"? Not traffic. So main charge: "过失致人死亡". Also maybe "非法经营特种作业"? Not criminal.

Thus answer: [罪名]过失致人死亡<eoa>

Check if any other charges like "玩忽职守"? He is owner, not public official. So just one.
